title: DIASENTINEL: An Auditable Multi-Agent System for Guideline-Grounded Diabetes Risk Screening
abstract: arXiv:2608.31128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising clinical decision support but remain vulnerable to hallucinated facts, unsupported recommendations, and citation errors. We present DIASENTINEL, a fully on-premise multi-agent system for one-year type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) risk screening and guideline-grounded report generation from electronic health records (EHRs). The system integrates calibrated risk prediction, deterministic clinical signal extraction, Reciprocal Rank Fusion over American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines, and a hybrid verification layer combining rule-based checks with LLM entailment. The demonstration provides a real-time batch-screening dashboard and an interactive patient report interface with cited recommendations, verification results, and raw EHR comparison. DIASENTINEL demonstrates a practical framework for reliable, auditable, and privacy-preserving LLM-based clinical decision support.

translated_title: DIASENTINEL：一个可审计的基于指南的糖尿病风险筛查多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）为临床决策支持带来了广阔前景，但仍容易出现幻觉事实、无依据的推荐以及引用错误等问题。我们提出了DIASENTINEL，这是一个完全本地化部署的多智能体系统，用于基于电子健康记录（EHR）进行一年期2型糖尿病（T2DM）风险筛查和基于指南的报告生成。该系统集成了校准的风险预测、确定性的临床信号提取、基于美国糖尿病协会（ADA）指南的倒数排名融合，以及结合基于规则的检查与LLM蕴含判断的混合验证层。该演示提供了实时批量筛查仪表板和交互式患者报告界面，包含引用的推荐建议、验证结果以及原始EHR对比。DIASENTINEL展示了一个可靠、可审计且保护隐私的基于LLM的临床决策支持的实用框架。
tldr: DIASENTINEL是一个完全本地化部署的多智能体系统，通过整合校准风险预测、确定性临床信号提取、基于ADA指南的检索融合以及规则检查与LLM蕴含相结合的混合验证层，实现了可靠、可审计且保护隐私的2型糖尿病风险筛查与报告生成。
en_tdlr: DIASENTINEL is a fully on-premise multi-agent system that integrates calibrated risk prediction, deterministic clinical signal extraction, ADA guideline-based retrieval fusion, and a hybrid verification layer to enable reliable, auditable, and privacy-preserving LLM-based type 2 diabetes risk screening and report generation.
